title: Imputing Missing Covariate Values in Nonlinear Models
title_zh: 非线性模型中缺失协变量值的插补
title_primary: 非线性模型中缺失协变量值的插补
title_secondary: Imputing Missing Covariate Values in Nonlinear Models
authors: Bhavna Rai
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: I propose a new imputation estimator for missing covariate values in nonlinear models. The estimator provides efficiency gains relative to just using the complete cases, and is consistent for any model that falls under M‐estimation. This is unlike the commonly used dummy variable method and regression imputation, which I show to be generally inconsistent in nonlinear models. The proposed estimator is straightforward to implement, and relies only on the commonly used assumptions on missingness. To test these assumptions, I provide a novel and simple variable addition test. I show how the framework applies to nonlinear models for fractional and nonnegative responses.
abstract_zh: 我提出了一种新的插补估计量，用于非线性模型中缺失协变量值的处理。该估计量相较于仅使用完整案例的方法能带来效率提升，并且对于任何属于M估计框架的模型均具有一致性。这与常用的虚拟变量方法和回归插补不同，我证明后者在非线性模型中通常不一致。所提出的估计量实施简便，仅依赖于关于缺失性的常用假设。为检验这些假设，我提供了一种新颖且简单的变量添加检验。我展示了该框架如何应用于分数响应和非负响应的非线性模型。

title: Optimal Export Taxes in Global Value Chain
title_zh: 全球价值链中的最优出口税
title_primary: 全球价值链中的最优出口税
title_secondary: Optimal Export Taxes in Global Value Chain
authors: Yuting Gao
official: 官方在线 2026-08-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The determinants and optimality of implemented export taxes have long been understudied. In this work, I analyze how a country's optimal export taxes on products are influenced by their usage as inputs in traded final products. I decompose the influence of input–output linkages in the Global Value Chain (GVC) on optimal export policy into three channels in a two‐country trade model with multiple industries and roundabout production. Using China's applied export taxes from 2003 to 2012, I empirically demonstrate that the terms‐of‐trade effect and the three GVC effects are partially accounted for in China's export tax rates. The GVC effects underwent changes following the Global Financial Crisis in 2008. The comparison between calibrated optimal export tax rates and applied export tax rates reveals political bias in China's export tax on differentiated products, particularly in incorporating GVC effects.
abstract_zh: 已实施的出口税的决定因素及其最优性长期以来未得到充分研究。本文分析了一国对产品的最优出口税如何受到这些产品作为贸易最终产品投入品使用的影响。我在一个包含多行业及循环生产的两国贸易模型中，将全球价值链（GVC）中的投入产出关联对最优出口政策的影响分解为三个渠道。利用中国2003年至2012年实施的出口税数据，我实证表明，贸易条件效应及三种GVC效应在中国出口税率中得到了部分体现。GVC效应在2008年全球金融危机后发生了变化。校准的最优出口税率与实际实施的出口税率之间的比较揭示了中国对差异化产品出口税中的政治偏向，尤其是在纳入GVC效应方面。

title: Oil Prices, Gasoline Prices and Inflation Expectations: A New Model and New Facts
title_zh: 油价、汽油价格与通胀预期：一个新模型与新事实
title_primary: 油价、汽油价格与通胀预期：一个新模型与新事实
title_secondary: Oil Prices, Gasoline Prices and Inflation Expectations: A New Model and New Facts
authors: Lutz Kilian, Xiaoqing Zhou
official: 官方在线 2020-08-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The conventional wisdom that inflation expectations respond to the level of the price of oil (or the price of gasoline) is based on testing the null hypothesis of a zero slope coefficient in a static single-equation regression model fit to aggregate data. Given that the regressor in this model is not stationary, the null distribution of the t-test statistic is nonstandard, invalidating the use of the normal approximation. Once the critical values are adjusted, these regressions provide no support for the conventional wisdom. Using a new structural vector regression model, however, we demonstrate that gasoline price shocks may indeed drive one-year household inflation expectations. The model shows that there have been several such episodes since 1990. In particular, the rise in household inflation expectations between 2009 and 2013 is almost entirely explained by a large increase in gasoline prices. However, on average, gasoline price shocks account for only 39% of the variation in household inflation expectations since 1981.
abstract_zh: 传统观点认为通胀预期会响应石油价格（或汽油价格）水平，这一观点基于对总体数据拟合的静态单方程回归模型中斜率系数为零的原假设进行检验。鉴于该模型中的回归变量非平稳，t检验统计量的原假设分布非标准，使得正态近似的使用失效。一旦调整临界值，这些回归结果便不再支持传统观点。然而，通过采用一种新的结构向量回归模型，我们证明汽油价格冲击确实可能驱动一年期家庭通胀预期。该模型显示，自1990年以来已出现多次此类情形。特别是，2009年至2013年间家庭通胀预期的上升几乎完全由汽油价格的大幅上涨所解释。然而，平均而言，自1981年以来，汽油价格冲击仅解释了家庭通胀预期变动的39%。

title: The Labour Market and Health Effects of a Diabetes Warning: Evidence of Gender and Age Differences from the Lifelines Cohort Study
title_zh: 糖尿病警示对劳动力市场与健康的影响：来自Lifelines队列研究中性别与年龄差异的证据
title_primary: 糖尿病警示对劳动力市场与健康的影响：来自Lifelines队列研究中性别与年龄差异的证据
title_secondary: The Labour Market and Health Effects of a Diabetes Warning: Evidence of Gender and Age Differences from the Lifelines Cohort Study
authors: Annibali, Claudio, Bergemann, Annette, Alessie, Rob
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Health screenings are potentially powerful tools to mitigate adverse health and labour outcomes. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of the labour market and health effects of a diabetes warning in a country that has not introduced such a screening system. Using data from over 160, 000 participants in Lifelines, a Dutch cohort study, and a multidimensional regression discontinuity design, we estimate the short- and long-run impacts of a diabetes risk warning. Individuals under 40 increase their employment rate following a warning, with effects that are especially pronounced and persistent for women. These employment gains are accompanied by improvements in self-reported health among women and reduced smoking among men. Among older individuals, the responses are more heterogeneous: Women are more likely to retire and reduce alcohol consumption, while men are less likely to receive disability benefits and more likely to visit their general practitioner in the short term. Our findings provide novel evidence that health information can influence labour market outcomes through gender- and age-specific behavioural adjustments.
abstract_zh: 健康筛查是缓解不良健康与劳动结果的潜在有力工具。我们对一个尚未引入此类筛查制度的国家中糖尿病警示对劳动力市场及健康的影响进行了全面评估。利用荷兰队列研究Lifelines中超过16万名参与者的数据，并采用多维回归断点设计，我们估计了糖尿病风险警示的短期与长期影响。40岁以下的个体在收到警示后就业率上升，这一效应在女性中尤为显著且持久。这些就业增长伴随着女性自报健康状况的改善以及男性吸烟行为的减少。在年长个体中，反应更为异质：女性更可能退休并减少饮酒，而男性短期内更不可能领取残疾补助，且更可能就诊于全科医生。我们的发现提供了新颖证据，表明健康信息可通过性别与年龄特定的行为调整影响劳动力市场结果。

title: U.S. Monetary Spillovers to Emerging Markets: Both Policy Drivers and Vulnerabilities Matter
title_zh: 美国货币政策对新兴市场的溢出效应：政策驱动因素与脆弱性均至关重要
title_primary: 美国货币政策对新兴市场的溢出效应：政策驱动因素与脆弱性均至关重要
title_secondary: U.S. Monetary Spillovers to Emerging Markets: Both Policy Drivers and Vulnerabilities Matter
authors: Shaghil Ahmed, Ozge Akinci, Albert Queralto
official: 官方在线 2026-06-16 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: How do U.S. monetary tightening shocks affect emerging market economies, and how does the impact depend on these economies' own macroeconomic vulnerabilities? We examine this question in a model that combines financial frictions with imperfect anchoring of inflation expectations, a key vulnerability in emerging markets. The degree of anchoring is disciplined using evidence that inflation expectations in emerging markets respond significantly to inflation surprises. Imperfect anchoring amplifies the contractionary effects of U.S. monetary shocks on emerging markets but also generates increases in inflation and nominal interest rates, patterns that we show are consistent with the empirical evidence but are not well explained by existing models. Our analysis also distinguishes between the drivers of U.S. policy tightenings. U.S. interest rate hikes resulting from stronger demand, rather than exogenous policy shocks, lead to modestly positive spillovers for emerging markets with well-anchored inflation expectations, but to substantial slowdowns in those with less-well-anchored expectations.
abstract_zh: 美国的货币政策紧缩冲击如何影响新兴市场经济体，以及这种影响如何取决于这些经济体自身的宏观经济脆弱性？我们在一个结合金融摩擦与通胀预期锚定不完善的模型中探讨了这一问题，后者是新兴市场的一个关键脆弱性。锚定程度通过新兴市场通胀预期对通胀意外显著反应的证据加以约束。不完善的锚定放大了美国货币冲击对新兴市场的紧缩效应，但也导致通胀和名义利率上升，我们表明这些模式与实证证据一致，但现有模型未能充分解释。我们的分析还区分了美国政策收紧的驱动因素。由需求增强而非外生政策冲击引起的美国利率上调，对通胀预期锚定良好的新兴市场产生温和的正向溢出效应，但对锚定较差的经济体则导致显著的经济放缓。

title: Fairness perceptions of redistribution and predistribution
title_zh: 再分配与预分配中的公平感知
title_primary: 再分配与预分配中的公平感知
title_secondary: Fairness perceptions of redistribution and predistribution
authors: Krishna Srinivasan, Justin Valasek, Weijia Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: To address rising income inequality, governments typically rely on two levers: predistribution policies that implement inequality reduction before incomes are earned—e.g., minimum-wage laws—and redistribution policies that implement inequality reduction after incomes are earned—e.g., taxes and transfers. We explore whether support for reducing inequality depends on the choice of policy lever. Using incentivized experiments with the general population of the US and Sweden ( N = 2510 ), we study inequality reduction under predistribution and redistribution, focusing on whether inequality reduction is implemented before or after income is earned. We find that timing matters: subjects in both countries reduce inequality more under predistribution than redistribution. Furthermore, subjects in the predistribution treatment more often invoke equal effort to justify reducing inequality, while those in the redistribution treatment more often invoke adherence to the initial agreement to justify preserving it. Overall, our results imply that the choice between predistribution and redistribution can influence public support for reducing inequality.
abstract_zh: 为应对日益加剧的收入不平等，政府通常依赖两种手段：一是事前分配政策，即在收入产生之前实施不平等削减，如最低工资法；二是再分配政策，即在收入产生之后实施不平等削减，如税收和转移支付。我们探讨了减少不平等的支持度是否取决于政策手段的选择。通过对美国和瑞典普通人群的激励性实验（样本量N=2510），我们研究了事前分配与再分配下的不平等削减，重点关注不平等削减是在收入赚取之前还是之后实施。我们发现时机至关重要：两国受试者在事前分配下比在再分配下更倾向于减少不平等。此外，事前分配处理中的受试者更常援引平等努力来为减少不平等辩护，而再分配处理中的受试者则更常援引对初始协议的遵守来为维持不平等辩护。总体而言，我们的结果表明，事前分配与再分配之间的选择可能影响公众对减少不平等的支持度。

title: Different no more: Country spreads in advanced and emerging economies
title_zh: 不再不同：发达与新兴经济体的国家利差
title_primary: 不再不同：发达与新兴经济体的国家利差
title_secondary: Different no more: Country spreads in advanced and emerging economies
authors: Benjamin Born, Gernot J. Müller, Johannes Pfeifer, Susanne Wellmann
official: 官方在线 2026-07-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Interest rate spreads vary widely across time and countries and are a central driver of business cycles in emerging market economies (EMEs). Since 2008, advanced market economies (AMEs) have exhibited persistently higher and more volatile spreads, alongside increased macroeconomic volatility and stronger co-movement with EMEs. We document six facts showing that AMEs have become more similar to EMEs along key dimensions. We interpret these patterns through a small open economy model and uncover a stark dichotomy: higher spreads reflect greater indebtedness and lower debt tolerance, whereas greater macroeconomic volatility and co-movement are driven by stronger global shocks.
abstract_zh: 利率利差在不同时期和国家间差异显著，是新兴市场经济体（EMEs）商业周期的主要驱动力。自2008年以来，发达市场经济体（AMEs）表现出持续更高且更波动的利差，同时伴随宏观经济波动性增强以及与EMEs的联动性加强。我们记录了六项事实，表明AMEs在关键维度上已与EMEs更加相似。我们通过一个小型开放经济模型解释这些模式，并揭示了一个鲜明的二分法：更高的利差反映了更高的债务水平和较低的债务容忍度，而更大的宏观经济波动性和联动性则是由更强的全球冲击所驱动。

title: National Policies and Local Economies: Europe and the United States
title_zh: 国家政策与地方经济：欧洲与美国
title_primary: 国家政策与地方经济：欧洲与美国
title_secondary: National Policies and Local Economies: Europe and the United States
authors: Lucrezia Reichlin, Mario Forni, Sebnem Kalemli-Ozcan, Andrés Rodríguez-Pose, Lewis Dijkstra 等
official: 官方在线 1997-04-30 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies the synchronization of output fluctuations in European regions and US counties. We extend the two component dynamic factor model à la Sargent and Sims (1977) by introducing an intermediate-level shock, which is common to all regions (counties) in each country (state), but it is not common to Europe (United States) as a whole. We build on Forni and Reichlin (1995, 1996) to propose a simple method of estimation which is based on Law of Large Numbers results and exploits the large cross-sectional dimension of the data set. The empirical findings show that Europe has a level of integration similar to that of the United States. In general, we find that the national dimension in Europe is not very important: around 75% of output variance is explained by global and purely local dynamics. Similar numbers are found for US counties and US states. The study of the dynamic profile of the components, however, shows that Europe, unlike the United States, has no traditional business cycle. Shocks are very persistent and the bulk of the variance is in the long run. We also find a European core of regions with a particularly high level of integration. The core is not defined by a set of nations, however, but by regions belonging to different countries.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了欧洲地区与美国县级行政区的产出波动同步性。我们在Sargent和Sims（1977）提出的双成分动态因子模型基础上进行拓展，引入一个中间层级冲击——该冲击对每个国家（州）内的所有地区（县）具有共同影响，但并非整个欧洲（美国）的共性冲击。借鉴Forni和Reichlin（1995, 1996）的研究思路，我们提出一种基于大数定律结果、利用数据集大截面维度特征的简易估计方法。实证结果表明，欧洲的经济一体化程度与美国相当。总体而言，我们发现欧洲的国家维度并不显著：约75%的产出方差可由全球性因素与纯粹的地方性动态解释。美国县级与州级数据也呈现类似数值。然而，对成分动态特征的研究显示，欧洲与美国不同，不存在传统意义上的商业周期。冲击具有高度持续性，方差主体集中于长期效应。我们还发现存在一个由一体化程度特别高的地区构成的欧洲核心区，但该核心并非由特定国家集群界定，而是由分属不同国家的区域组成。

title: The Inflation Attention Threshold and Inflation Surges
title_zh: 通胀关注阈值与通胀激增
title_primary: 通胀关注阈值与通胀激增
title_secondary: The Inflation Attention Threshold and Inflation Surges
authors: Pfäuti, Oliver
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: The recent inflation surge brought inflation back on people’s minds. I quantify when and how much attention to inflation changes and derive the macroeconomic implications of these attention changes. I estimate an attention threshold at an inflation rate of 4 percent, that attention doubles when inflation exceeds this threshold, and that supply shocks have stronger and more persistent effects on inflation in times of high attention. Developing a model featuring the attention threshold, I show that attention changes offer a joint explanation for inflation surges, inflation’s co-movement with inflation expectations, and a long last mile of disinflation.
abstract_zh: 近期通胀飙升使人们重新关注通货膨胀。我量化了通胀关注度何时发生变化及其变化幅度，并推导出这些关注度变化对宏观经济的影响。我估算出通胀关注度的阈值为4%的通胀率——当通胀超过这一阈值时，关注度会翻倍——且在高关注度时期，供给冲击对通胀的影响更强且更持久。通过构建一个包含关注度阈值的模型，我证明关注度变化能够共同解释通胀飙升、通胀与通胀预期的联动关系，以及去通胀进程中“最后一公里”的漫长过程。

title: The impact of pension reforms and rapid aging on savings and labor supply: The case of China
title_zh: 养老金改革与快速老龄化对储蓄和劳动供给的影响：以中国为例
title_primary: 养老金改革与快速老龄化对储蓄和劳动供给的影响：以中国为例
title_secondary: The impact of pension reforms and rapid aging on savings and labor supply: The case of China
authors: Hui He, Lei Ning, Dongming Zhu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Over the past three decades, China has experienced substantial reductions in social security benefits due to pension reforms and undergone profound demographic changes. By combining empirical studies and quantitative analyses in a general equilibrium setting, this paper examines the effects of China’s pension reforms and rapid population aging on household saving and labor supply behaviors. Calibrating the model to the Chinese economy, we find that the pension reforms alone account for approximately 25 percent of the increase in the household saving rate between 1995 and 2009, and 49 percent of the sharp rise in labor supply over the same period. These effects are significantly amplified by rapid aging. Our study demonstrates that both household saving and labor supply serve as quantitatively important self-insurance channels in response to changes in pension generosity and longevity risk.
abstract_zh: 过去三十年间，中国因养老金改革经历了社会保障福利的大幅缩减，并发生了深刻的人口结构变化。通过结合实证研究与一般均衡框架下的定量分析，本文考察了中国养老金改革及快速人口老龄化对家庭储蓄和劳动供给行为的影响。将模型校准至中国经济数据后，我们发现，仅养老金改革一项，就解释了1995年至2009年间家庭储蓄率上升的约25%，以及同期劳动供给急剧增长的49%。这些效应因快速老龄化而显著放大。本研究证明，家庭储蓄与劳动供给均为应对养老金慷慨度变化及长寿风险的重要数量级自我保险渠道。

title: Facing the Hard Truth: Evidence from Climate Change Ignorance
title_zh: 面对残酷真相：来自气候变化忽视的证据
title_primary: 面对残酷真相：来自气候变化忽视的证据
title_secondary: Facing the Hard Truth: Evidence from Climate Change Ignorance
authors: Ferenc Szucs, Pamela Campa
official: 官方在线 2026-07-18 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In 2025, only 60% of Americans believed in human-caused climate change, despite a strong consensus in the scientific community. This paper argues that motivated reasoning contributes to climate-change ignorance. Using a difference-in-differences design we show that layoffs in the coal-mining sector increases the share of believers in climate change. Comparing layoffs in coal mining to manufacturing confirms that the effect is specific to employment in the fossil fuel industry. Finally, we find no comparable shifts in beliefs on unrelated policy issues, suggesting that changes in climate views reflect specific self-image dynamics rather than a broader opinion shifts.
abstract_zh: 2025年，尽管科学界已形成强烈共识，但仅有60%的美国人相信人类活动导致气候变化。本文论证了动机性推理是造成气候变化认知缺失的原因之一。通过双重差分法设计，我们发现煤炭开采行业的裁员提高了气候变化信仰者的比例。将煤炭开采业裁员与制造业裁员进行对比，证实该效应仅针对化石燃料行业的就业情况。最后，我们在无关政策议题上未发现类似信念转变，这表明气候变化观点的变化反映了特定的自我形象动态，而非更广泛的意见转变。

title: Universal Basic Income: Inspecting the Mechanisms
title_zh: 全民基本收入：机制探析
title_primary: 全民基本收入：机制探析
title_secondary: Universal Basic Income: Inspecting the Mechanisms
authors: Nir Jaimovich, Itay Saporta-Eksten, Ofer Setty, Yaniv Yedid-Levi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine the mechanisms driving the aggregate and distributional impacts of Universal Basic Income (UBI) through model analysis of various UBI programs and financing schemes. The main adverse effect is the distortionary tax increase to fund UBI, reducing labor force participation. Secondary channels are a decline in demand for self-insurance, depressing aggregate capital, and a positive income effect that further deters labor force participation. Due to these channels, introducing UBI alongside existing social programs reduces output and average welfare. Partially substituting existing programs with UBI mitigates the adverse effects, increases average welfare, but does not deliver a Pareto improvement.
abstract_zh: 我们通过模型分析各类全民基本收入（UBI）方案及其融资机制，探究驱动UBI总体影响与分配效应的内在机制。主要负面效应在于为资助UBI而增加的扭曲性税收，导致劳动力参与率下降。次要传导渠道包括：自我保险需求降低抑制总资本积累，以及正向收入效应进一步削弱劳动供给意愿。由于这些传导机制，在现有社会计划基础上引入UBI会降低产出与平均福利水平。若以UBI部分替代现有计划，虽能缓解负面效应并提升平均福利，但无法实现帕累托改进。

title: Ratings design and barriers to entry
title_zh: 评级设计与进入壁垒
title_primary: 评级设计与进入壁垒
title_secondary: Ratings design and barriers to entry
authors: Nikhil Vellodi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: I study the impact of consumer reviews on the incentives for firms to participate in the market. I develop a model of endogenous entry in which firms produce goods of heterogeneous, unknown quality. Consumers engage in directed search, and prices are exogenously fixed. A rater uses consumer reviews to construct firm‐specific ratings that are informative of quality and help consumers direct their search. The main insight of the paper is that suppressing the reviews of highly‐rated firms strengthens entry incentives and improves consumer welfare.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了消费者评价对企业参与市场激励的影响。我构建了一个内生进入模型，其中企业生产异质性且质量未知的商品。消费者进行定向搜索，价格外生给定。评级机构利用消费者评价构建企业特定评级，该评级能反映质量信息并帮助消费者引导搜索。本文的核心发现是：抑制高评级企业的评价会增强企业进入市场的激励，并提升消费者福利。

title: Trade Tensions and the Reconfiguration of Supply Chain Linkages: Evidence From U.S. Listed Firms
title_zh: 贸易紧张与供应链关联重构：来自美国上市公司的证据
title_primary: 贸易紧张与供应链关联重构：来自美国上市公司的证据
title_secondary: Trade Tensions and the Reconfiguration of Supply Chain Linkages: Evidence From U.S. Listed Firms
authors: Xiaohua Bao, Jianpeng Deng, Yue Lu, Yaning Wei, Jie Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-06-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In recent years, the acceleration of de‐globalization has reconfigured global supply chains. Using listed firm‐level global supplier‐customer relationship data from the FactSet Revere database spanning January 2017 to December 2019, this paper examines whether and how firm‐supplier relationships change after the U.S.–China trade tensions. Our findings indicate that the U.S.–China trade tensions are followed by a significant relative decline in U.S. listed firms' reliance on direct Chinese suppliers. This phenomenon is pronounced in the manufacturing and information industries, especially in high‐tech industries. Mechanism analysis suggests that, following the trade frictions, U.S. firms appear to reduce their reliance on direct Chinese suppliers by diversifying and shortening contracts, while also taking adjustment costs into account. The extended analysis explicitly shows that U.S. firms continue to rely on China indirectly—via upstream inputs embedded in domestic suppliers and through third‐country firms closely tied to Chinese production networks. Additionally, U.S. firms tend to increase supplier links with countries that have higher institutional quality, consistent with a search for greater supply chain ‘security’.
abstract_zh: 近年来，去全球化进程加速，全球供应链格局随之重构。本文利用FactSet Revere数据库2017年1月至2019年12月期间美国上市公司层面的全球供应商-客户关系数据，考察中美贸易摩擦是否以及如何改变企业-供应商关系。研究发现，中美贸易摩擦后，美国上市公司对中国直接供应商的依赖程度出现显著相对下降。这一现象在制造业与信息行业尤为突出，特别是高科技领域。机制分析表明，贸易摩擦发生后，美国企业通过多元化供应商选择与缩短合同期限来降低对中国直接供应商的依赖，同时兼顾调整成本。拓展分析进一步揭示，美国企业仍通过嵌入国内供应商的上游投入品以及与华生产网络紧密关联的第三国企业，间接依赖中国。此外，美国企业倾向于增加与制度质量较高国家的供应商联系，这与寻求更高供应链"安全性"的行为一致。

title: Experimental results on the roommate problem
title_zh: 室友问题的实验结果
title_primary: 室友问题的实验结果
title_secondary: Experimental results on the roommate problem
authors: Elena Molis, Róbert F. Veszteg
official: 官方在线 2026-06-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We use laboratory experiments to analyze decentralized decision-making in one-sided matching markets. We find that subjects tend to make decisions in line with most theoretical models, as their offering and accepting decisions are mainly guided by the objective of improving upon the status quo. In consequence, markets move towards satisfying blocking pairs making the number of remaining blocking pairs diminish and the aggregate payoffs increase over time. Overall, the theoretical solutions of absorbing sets and stable matchings to the roommate problem are supported by the experimental results. However, not all matchings in an absorbing set have the same power of attraction in the experimental laboratory. The theoretical property of P-stability refines absorbing sets as predictors of final outcomes.
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们通过实验室实验分析单边匹配市场中的分散决策。研究发现，受试者的决策行为与多数理论模型一致，其提议与接受决策主要受改善现状这一目标驱动。因此，市场会逐步消除阻碍配对，使剩余阻碍配对数量随时间递减，总收益随之增长。总体而言，室友问题中吸收集与稳定匹配的理论解得到了实验结果的验证。然而，实验室中吸收集内的不同匹配并非具有同等吸引力。理论上的P稳定性性质可进一步将吸收集精炼为最终结果的预测指标。

title: Dynamic central bank credibility: a Kalman Filter–Recursive Least Squares approach for emerging markets
title_zh: 动态中央银行可信度：新兴市场的卡尔曼滤波–递归最小二乘法
title_primary: 动态中央银行可信度：新兴市场的卡尔曼滤波–递归最小二乘法
title_secondary: Dynamic central bank credibility: a Kalman Filter–Recursive Least Squares approach for emerging markets
authors: Valverde-Ambriz, Ismael D.
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop a state-space framework that jointly estimates central bank credibility as a scalar latent variable and the associated time-varying monetary policy reaction function. The Kalman filter extracts an unobservable credibility index from observed inflation expectations, while Recursive Least Squares continuously updates the reaction function coefficients using the Kalman innovations sequence, ensuring that parameter estimation operates on long-run trend components rather than transitory fluctuations. Under standard regularity conditions, we establish consistency of the credibility estimator and show that the reaction function coefficients attain the Cramer-Rao bound when the innovation variance is constant; a GLS variant achieves efficiency in the heteroskedastic case. Applying the framework to Banco de Mexico over 2002-2024, we identify four distinct credibility regimes: a consolidation phase following the adoption of inflation targeting (2002-2008), a transitory shock during the global financial crisis (2008-2009), a sustained high-credibility equilibrium (2010-2020), and a stress episode associated with post-pandemic inflation (2021-2023) followed by partial recovery. The time-varying reaction coefficients reveal that Banco de Mexico's responsiveness to the inflation gap is itself a function of its credibility state: stronger anchoring permits a more measured policy response, while credibility deterioration triggers sharper, front-loaded adjustments. These findings have direct implications for the optimal design of monetary policy communication in emerging markets and for the broader debate on whether central bank credibility generates real persistent effects beyond its role in expectation coordination.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个状态空间框架，将央行可信度作为标量潜变量与随时间变化的货币政策反应函数进行联合估计。卡尔曼滤波从观测到的通胀预期中提取不可观测的可信度指数，而递推最小二乘法则利用卡尔曼创新序列持续更新反应函数系数，确保参数估计基于长期趋势成分而非暂时性波动。在标准正则性条件下，我们证明了可信度估计量的一致性，并表明当创新方差恒定时，反应函数系数达到克拉美-罗下界；在异方差情形下，广义最小二乘变体可实现有效性。将该框架应用于2002-2024年期间的墨西哥银行，我们识别出四个不同的可信度区间：通胀目标制实施后的巩固阶段（2002-2008年）、全球金融危机期间的暂时冲击（2008-2009年）、持续的高可信度均衡（2010-2020年）、以及疫情后通胀相关的压力时期（2021-2023年）及随后的部分恢复。时变反应系数揭示，墨西哥银行对通胀缺口的反应程度本身是其可信度状态的函数：更强的锚定效应允许更审慎的政策回应，而可信度恶化则会触发更剧烈的前置调整。这些发现对新兴市场货币政策沟通的最优设计，以及关于央行可信度是否在预期协调作用之外产生真实持久效应的广泛讨论，具有直接启示意义。

title: Prospect-Theory Behavior from Bellman Optimality in MDPs with Catastrophic States
title_zh: 具有灾难状态的MDP中来自贝尔曼最优性的前景理论行为
title_primary: 具有灾难状态的MDP中来自贝尔曼最优性的前景理论行为
title_secondary: Prospect-Theory Behavior from Bellman Optimality in MDPs with Catastrophic States
authors: Yujiao Chen
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study risk-neutral control in Markov decision processes with an absorbing catastrophic state. Even though rewards are linear and the agent has no utility curvature, probability weighting, or framing dependence, standard Bellman optimality produces three prospect-theory-like signatures: an S-shaped value-function profile (convex near catastrophe, concave in the far field), an endogenous loss-sensitivity coefficient $\lambda^*(S) > 1$, and a reflection-effect policy reversal. Across 495 configurations, the optimal policy plays safe near catastrophe in positive-drift (growth) regimes despite the risky action's higher immediate expected value, and plays risky near catastrophe in negative-drift (decline) regimes despite the safe action's lower immediate expected loss. We derive a closed-form expression for the asymptotic loss-aversion plateau $\bar{\lambda}$ that depends only on win probability $p$, payoff asymmetry $r = |\Delta_\ell/\Delta_w|$, and discount factor $\beta$, and matches numerical solutions to $R^2 = 0.999$. The mechanism does not require asymmetric payoffs. Across a sweep of $(p, \beta)$ at three asymmetry levels, the asymmetry share of $\bar{\lambda}$ above unity has median 4.6% at $r = 1.25$ and rises to 13.9% at $r = 2$, with the boundary contribution exceeding the asymmetry contribution in every cell tested. The phenomena persist under tabular Q-learning (a model-free agent reproduces $V^*$ at correlation 0.98 in growth and 1.00 in decline) and under stochastic transitions with Gaussian, heavy-tailed Student-$t_3$, and asymmetric skew-normal noise up to 50% of the step size, where the asymptotic plateau tracks the closed-form prediction within 0.41% for safe-channel noise and within 9.6% for risky-channel or both-channel noise. These results identify absorbing failure states as a sufficient structural mechanism for prospect-theory-like behavior under optimal control.
abstract_zh: 本文研究含吸收灾难状态的马尔可夫决策过程中的风险中性控制问题。尽管奖励函数为线性且决策者不存在效用曲率、概率权重或框架依赖，标准贝尔曼最优性仍产生三种类似前景理论的特征：S形价值函数轮廓（近灾难区域凸性、远场区域凹性）、内生的损失敏感系数$\lambda^*(S) > 1$，以及反射效应策略反转。在495种配置中，最优策略在正漂移（增长）模式下于近灾难区域选择保守策略（尽管风险行为具有更高的即时期望价值），而在负漂移（衰退）模式下于近灾难区域选择风险策略（尽管保守行为具有更低的即时期望损失）。我们推导出渐近损失厌恶平台$\bar{\lambda}$的闭式表达式，该表达式仅取决于获胜概率$p$、收益不对称性$r = |\Delta_\ell/\Delta_w|$和贴现因子$\beta$，且与数值解的拟合优度达$R^2 = 0.999$。该机制无需非对称收益。在三种不对称水平下对$(p, \beta)$进行全参数扫描时，$\bar{\lambda}$大于1的部分中，不对称性贡献的中位数在$r = 1.25$时为4.6%，在$r = 2$时升至13.9%，且所有测试单元中边界贡献均超过不对称性贡献。该现象在表格型Q学习（无模型智能体在增长模式下与$V^*$的相关性为0.98，在衰退模式下为1.00）以及随机转移过程中（高斯噪声、重尾Student-$t_3$噪声、非对称偏态正态噪声，噪声幅度最高达步长的50%）均持续存在，其中渐近平台在安全通道噪声下与闭式预测的偏差在0.41%以内，在风险通道或双通道噪声下偏差在9.6%以内。这些结果表明，吸收失败状态是产生最优控制下类似前景理论行为的充分结构性机制。

title: Managed urbanization and agricultural productivity: evidence from China’s New-type urbanization pilot program
title_zh: 管理型城市化与农业生产力：来自中国新型城镇化试点项目的证据
title_primary: 管理型城市化与农业生产力：来自中国新型城镇化试点项目的证据
title_secondary: Managed urbanization and agricultural productivity: evidence from China’s New-type urbanization pilot program
authors: Tianxiang Li, Yuanyi Liao, Tomas Baležentis, Zhiyang Shen
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Urbanization is reshaping agriculture in many low- and middle-income countries, but how this process influences innovation-led agricultural productivity growth remains an open question. This paper studies China’s New-type Urbanization Pilot Program (NTUP), launched in 2014, which combined rural land tenure reforms, hukou system adjustments, and targeted infrastructure investment to promote two-way factor flows between cities and villages. We exploit the program’s staggered rollout across counties and estimate its effects on agricultural total factor productivity (TFP) using a multi-period difference-in-differences design. Drawing on a balanced panel of 1,329 Chinese counties for 2000–2023, we show that the NTUP raises agricultural total factor productivity by about 17–19% in pilot counties, with gains unfolding gradually over time. These gains operate through multiple reinforcing channels, including better integration of factor markets, a shift in farm labor toward mechanized production, and faster technology diffusion. The productivity effects were largest in counties geographically remote from provincial capitals, where market-driven urbanization tends to bypass. Our findings indicate that the returns to urbanization for agriculture are largest when programs explicitly combine institutional reform with geographically inclusive public investment. This design principle offers practical lessons for other developing economies navigating the relationship between rapid urban growth and food security.
abstract_zh: 城市化正在重塑许多中低收入国家的农业格局，但这一过程如何影响以创新为主导的农业生产力增长仍是一个悬而未决的问题。本文研究了中国于2014年启动的新型城镇化试点项目（NTUP），该项目结合了农村土地制度改革、户籍制度调整及定向基础设施投资，旨在促进城乡之间要素的双向流动。我们利用该试点项目在县级层面的分阶段推广，采用多期双重差分设计，评估其对农业全要素生产率（TFP）的影响。基于2000—2023年间1,329个中国县的平衡面板数据，我们发现NTUP使试点县的农业全要素生产率提高了约17%—19%，且这一增益随时间逐步显现。这些增益通过多重相互强化的渠道发挥作用，包括要素市场的更好整合、农业劳动力向机械化生产转移以及技术扩散的加速。生产力效应在距离省会较远、市场化驱动的城市化往往难以覆盖的县份最为显著。我们的研究结果表明，当项目明确将制度性改革与具有地理包容性的公共投资相结合时，城市化对农业的回报最为可观。这一设计原则为其他正在应对快速城市增长与粮食安全关系的发展中经济体提供了切实可行的经验借鉴。

title: How Does Information Influence Consumers' Evaluation of Biofortified Foods? A Meta‐Regression Analysis
title_zh: 信息如何影响消费者对生物强化食品的评价？一项元回归分析
title_primary: 信息如何影响消费者对生物强化食品的评价？一项元回归分析
title_secondary: How Does Information Influence Consumers' Evaluation of Biofortified Foods? A Meta‐Regression Analysis
authors: Fuli Tan, Jingjing Wang, Yixuan Guo, Joshua Wesana, Taian Deng 等
official: 官方在线 2026-05-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Biofortified foods offer a promising solution to micronutrient deficiencies affecting billions worldwide, yet their potential remains constrained by limited consumer acceptance. While information plays a critical role in shaping consumers' evaluation of biofortified food products, existing evidence on its effectiveness in improving acceptance remains inconclusive across different contexts. Moreover, there is a notable lack of systematic synthesis of the effects of information interventions, particularly given the wide variation in outcome measures used in the literature. This study examines how information influences consumer evaluations of biofortified foods and identifies factors that moderate its impact. Using meta‐regression analysis based on 87 effect sizes from 34 empirical studies across 22 countries, we estimate the average effect of information provision and explore the influencing factors. Results from random‐effects models and weighted least squares regressions show that information has a significant though modest positive effect on consumer evaluation (Cohen's d = 0.27, 95% CI: 0.25–0.30). Variations in impacts can be explained by product characteristics, information design, study design and contextual factors. Future intervention campaigns should be tailored to enhance consumer acceptance and support biofortified food deployment in regions with nutritional deficits.
abstract_zh: 摘要 生物强化食品为解决影响全球数十亿人的微量营养素缺乏问题提供了一种有前景的方案，但其潜力仍受限于消费者接受度不高。尽管信息在塑造消费者对生物强化食品的评价中起着关键作用，但现有关于其提升接受度有效性的证据在不同情境下尚无定论。此外，鉴于文献中结果测量指标的广泛差异，对信息干预效果的系统性综合研究明显不足。本研究考察信息如何影响消费者对生物强化食品的评价，并识别调节其影响的因素。基于对22个国家34项实证研究中87个效应量的元回归分析，我们估计了信息提供的平均效应并探讨了影响因素。随机效应模型和加权最小二乘回归的结果显示，信息对消费者评价具有显著但适度的正向效应（Cohen's d = 0.27，95%置信区间：0.25–0.30）。影响的差异可由产品特征、信息设计、研究设计和情境因素来解释。未来的干预活动应量身定制，以提升消费者接受度，并支持生物强化食品在营养缺乏地区的推广。

title: The employment effects of disability benefit reassessment
title_zh: 残疾津贴重新评估的就业效应
title_primary: 残疾津贴重新评估的就业效应
title_secondary: The employment effects of disability benefit reassessment
authors: Anikó Bíró, Cecília Hornok, Judit Krekó, Dániel Prinz, Ágota Scharle
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the consequences of a large-scale reassessment of the health and working capacity of disability insurance beneficiaries in Hungary. Leveraging birthday and health cutoffs in the reassessment, we estimate employment responses to the threat of disability benefit loss and the actual termination or reduction of benefits. We show that due to the threat of benefit removal, many beneficiaries stopped working after the reassessment was announced but before it took place. Another group of beneficiaries lost their benefits and increased their labor supply significantly. Overall, the reassessment had a negative short-term and neutral medium-term impact on employment and earnings. Our results suggest that unintended responses to the threat of benefit loss operate as a substitution effect that can reduce labor supply even without binding formal earnings limits, and thus should be considered in the design of reassessments.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了匈牙利对残疾保险受益人健康及工作能力的大规模重新评估所带来的后果。利用重新评估中的生日和健康临界点，我们估计了就业对残疾福利丧失威胁及实际终止或减少福利的反应。结果显示，由于福利取消的威胁，许多受益人在重新评估宣布后但实施前便停止了工作。另一部分受益人则失去了福利，并显著增加了劳动供给。总体而言，重新评估对就业和收入产生了短期负面及中期中性的影响。我们的研究结果表明，对福利丧失威胁的非预期反应作为一种替代效应，即便在没有正式收入限制的情况下也能减少劳动供给，因此在设计重新评估时应予以考虑。

title: Strategic Influencers and the Shaping of Beliefs
title_zh: 战略影响者与信念塑造
title_primary: 战略影响者与信念塑造
title_secondary: Strategic Influencers and the Shaping of Beliefs
authors: Akhil Vohra
official: 官方在线 2026-05-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Influencers, from propagandists to sellers, expend vast resources targeting agents who amplify their message through word-of-mouth communication. While agents differ in network position, they also differ in their bias: Agents may naturally read articles with a particular slant or buy products from a certain seller. Absent competition, an influencer prefers targeting central agents and those biased against it. If agents are unbiased, competition leads to influencers targeting more central agents. However, when agents have heterogeneous biases and competition is intense, the incentive to deter one's rival dominates. Influencers protect their base, targeting those with similar beliefs in equilibrium.
abstract_zh: 从宣传者到销售者，影响者投入大量资源瞄准那些通过口碑传播放大其信息的代理人。尽管代理人在网络位置上有差异，他们在偏见上也各不相同：代理人可能自然倾向于阅读特定倾向的文章或从特定卖家购买产品。在没有竞争的情况下，影响者偏好瞄准中心代理人及那些对其有偏见的代理人。若代理人无偏见，竞争促使影响者瞄准更中心的代理人。然而，当代理人具有异质性偏见且竞争激烈时，遏制对手的动机占据主导。影响者保护其基本盘，在均衡状态下瞄准信念相近的代理人。

title: Exposure to World War II and Its Labor Market Consequences over the Life Cycle
title_zh: 二战经历及其对生命周期劳动力市场的影响
title_primary: 二战经历及其对生命周期劳动力市场的影响
title_secondary: Exposure to World War II and Its Labor Market Consequences over the Life Cycle
authors: Braun, Sebastian Till, Stuhler, Jan
official: 官方在线 2026-04-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: With 70 million dead, World War II remains the most devastating conflict in history. Among the survivors, millions were displaced, returned maimed from the battlefield, or endured years of captivity. We examine the effects of such war exposures on labor market careers, showing that they often become apparent only at certain life stages. While war injuries reduced employment in old age, former prisoners of war prolonged their time in the workforce before retiring. Many displaced workers, especially women, never returned to employment. These responses align with standard life-cycle theory and thus likely hold relevance for other conflicts.
abstract_zh: 第二次世界大战造成7000万人死亡，仍是历史上最具破坏性的冲突。幸存者中，数百万人流离失所、从战场伤残归来或经历多年囚禁。我们考察了此类战争经历对劳动力市场职业生涯的影响，发现其影响往往仅在特定人生阶段显现。尽管战争创伤降低了老年期的就业率，但前战俘在退休前延长了工作时间。许多流离失所的劳动者——尤其是女性——再未重返工作岗位。这些反应符合标准生命周期理论，因此可能对其他冲突具有参考意义。

title: Temperature Sensitivity and Adaptation of Cereal Yields: Empirical Evidence From Italy
title_zh: 谷物产量的温度敏感性与适应性：来自意大利的经验证据
title_primary: 谷物产量的温度敏感性与适应性：来自意大利的经验证据
title_secondary: Temperature Sensitivity and Adaptation of Cereal Yields: Empirical Evidence From Italy
authors: Paolo Nota, Giacomo Coughlan, Alessandro Olper
official: 官方在线 2026-04-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper investigates the evolving temperature sensitivity and climate adaptation of cereal yields in Italy from 1952 to 2023, using province‐level data for maize, common wheat, and durum wheat. Employing panel data econometric methods, we estimate yield responses to heat exposure, changes in sensitivity over time, and adaptation to climate change. The findings reveal reduced heat sensitivity in maize, persistent sensitivity in common wheat, and some evidence of reduced heat sensitivity in durum wheat. The results also highlight mixed evidence of adaptation, as long‐run climate adaptation offsets some of the negative effects only on maize yield. Consequently, there is both potential for reducing heat impacts and concern about future vulnerability. This study provides novel evidence regarding the necessity of targeted agricultural strategies in enhancing climate resilience among cereal producers.
abstract_zh: 本文利用意大利省级层面的玉米、普通小麦和硬质小麦数据，考察了1952年至2023年间谷物产量对温度敏感性的演变及气候适应情况。采用面板数据计量经济学方法，我们估计了产量对高温暴露的响应、敏感性随时间的变化以及气候变化的适应效应。研究结果显示，玉米的热敏感性有所降低，普通小麦的敏感性持续存在，而硬质小麦则呈现出热敏感性下降的部分证据。结果还揭示了适应效应的混合证据，长期气候适应仅对玉米产量部分抵消了负面影响。因此，既存在减轻热影响的潜力，也需关注未来的脆弱性。本研究为针对性农业策略在增强谷物生产者气候韧性方面的必要性提供了新颖证据。

title: Spillover Effects of Monitoring: An Experiment on Lying
title_zh: 监督的溢出效应：一项关于说谎的实验
title_primary: 监督的溢出效应：一项关于说谎的实验
title_secondary: Spillover Effects of Monitoring: An Experiment on Lying
authors: Ninghua Du, Yi Yang
official: 官方在线 2025-11-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We experimentally investigate the spillover effects of monitoring. In a controlled laboratory experiment, participants simultaneously self‐report their payoffs in two tasks. Holding lies in the untargeted task to never be penalized, we vary the observability and the punishment for lying in the targeted task as follows: (1) the experimenter cannot observe the random draw that determines the payoff the participant should report, (2) the experimenter observes the participants' random draw, and (3) a penalty is imposed on the participant if the self‐reported payoff and the random draw are not consistent. The results showed that while participants lied less in the targeted task given a higher level of monitoring, they significantly increased their lies in the untargeted task.
abstract_zh: 我们通过实验研究了监督的溢出效应。在一项受控实验室实验中，参与者在两项任务中同时自我报告其收益。在未目标任务中的谎言永远不会受到惩罚的前提下，我们变化了目标任务中谎言的可见性和惩罚机制，具体如下：（1）实验者无法观察到决定参与者应报告收益的随机抽取结果，（2）实验者观察到参与者的随机抽取结果，以及（3）若自我报告的收益与随机抽取结果不一致，则对参与者施加惩罚。结果显示，尽管在更高水平的监督下，参与者在目标任务中减少了谎言，但他们显著增加了在未目标任务中的谎言。

title: Farm Profits, Prices and Household Behavior
title_zh: 农场利润、价格与家庭行为
title_primary: 农场利润、价格与家庭行为
title_secondary: Farm Profits, Prices and Household Behavior
authors: Advisory Board, Daniel LaFave, Evan Peet, Duncan Thomas
official: 官方在线 2024-10-16 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The agricultural household model, in which decisions about production and consumption are made simultaneously, lies at the heart of many models of development. Empirically modelling these simultaneous choices is not straightforward. The vast majority of empirical studies assume that farm-households behave as if markets are complete in which case decision-making simplifies to a recursive system where consumption choices can be treated as if they are made after all production decisions. Previous empirical tests of this assumption have relied on restrictions on production decisions. We develop a new approach to testing based on household consumption choices and implement the procedure using data from rural Indonesia. Relative to production-side tests, the consumption-based test is well-suited to identifying those farm-households in any setting whose behavior is consistent with complete markets and those for whom the assumption is rejected. We find the recursion assumption is not rejected for larger farmers but is rejected for small farmers. The tests are straightforward to implement and the results of the tests provide new opportunities to identify the behaviors that households adopt in the face of incomplete markets.
abstract_zh: 农业家庭模型将生产与消费决策视为同时进行的过程，这一模型构成了众多发展理论的核心。然而，对这些同步决策进行实证建模并非易事。绝大多数实证研究假设农户行为如同市场完全化，此时决策可简化为递归系统——即消费决策可被视为在所有生产决策完成后进行。此前对该假设的实证检验均依赖于对生产决策的约束条件。我们提出了一种基于家庭消费选择的新检验方法，并利用印度尼西亚农村数据实施该程序。相较于生产侧检验，消费侧检验更适用于识别任何情境下行为符合完全市场假设的农户，以及该假设被拒绝的农户。研究发现，递归假设未被大农户拒绝，但被小农户拒绝。该检验方法易于实施，其结果为识别家庭在不完全市场中的行为模式提供了新途径。
